parent_objective: audit whether M260/M261 staged PPO repeats are stable enough to admit medium PPO

public_gates: compare M260 and M261 raw exact-source movement
classify the next blocker before any medium PPO
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M262
do not promote a new checkpoint in M262
do not use private holdout evidence
do not start medium PPO until the audit decision is recorded
hypothesis: M261 passed promotion only at a tiny interpolation alpha because the repeated stage2 PPO direction is seed-fragile and remains constrained by protected-key source and normal-margin pressure.
success_criteria: M262 produces a source-aware comparison of M260 and M261 raw PPO movement
M262 identifies whether the limiting gate is exact protected-source regression, protected-key normal-margin pressure, replay row16 fragility, behavior regression, or training instability
M262 records a concrete next milestone decision without running new PPO
failure_criteria: audit artifacts are insufficient to explain the M260 versus M261 safe-alpha gap
M262 starts new PPO or tunes from private holdout evidence

commands.name: m262_fragility_audit
commands.command: Summarize M260 and M261 exact-source, interpolation-boundary, protected-key, replay, and behavior artifacts into a no-training audit.

decision_rule: M262 does not promote a checkpoint. It must decide whether the next step is another stage2 repeat, stronger protected-source repair, a stage2 config adjustment, or a cautious medium-PPO escalation.
